script.title: الحلقة التي لا تراها — The Loop You Never See

voice_performance.performance_intent: Arabic newsroom explainer, not a product pitch. A narrator who already knows the answer and is unhurried about it — authority from the mechanism, never from adjectives. No vocal smile, no hype, no rising sell on any line.
voice_performance.energy_curve: Flat and cold on the open (s1-s2), lifting into the reveal (s3), level and explanatory through the three phases (s4-s6) with s6 as the only accelerating line, dropping deliberately for the editorial beat (s7), building with the rotation (s8), warming for the reassurance (s9), then closing back down to the flatness it started on (s10).
voice_performance.pause_policy: Silence belongs to the animation. Every beat ends with a pause long enough for its visual to finish — longest after s3 (the cycle turns once unspoken), s6 (holding on green) and s7 (the split-ring still frame). Never speak over a reveal.

provider_notes.elevenlabs: Audition on s6 first — four verbs accelerating is where Arabic TTS prosody fails most audibly. Pick a voice with a neutral pan-Arab register, not a regional broadcast accent. provider_text carries SSML break tags; drop to plain punctuation if the chosen model ignores them.
provider_notes.piper_fallback: If the ar_JO-kareem fallback is ever approved, expect the SSML breaks to be ignored and the accent to read as Jordanian — s6 and s7 would need their timings re-cut by hand against the flat delivery.

sections.label: أنت
sections.speaker_directions: Open cold. No rising inflection. The whole hook is the smallness of the thing you did.

delivery_cues.energy: low, almost flat — a stated fact, not a tease
delivery_cues.delivery_note: Open cold. No rising inflection. The whole hook is the smallness of the thing you did.

enhancement_cues.description: Full-frame typographic assertion: one short Arabic prompt line, paper-white on near-black ink, stamped in word by word with no blur. A cursor holds at the end of the line and does nothing — the stillness is the point.

sections.label: ما حدث فعلاً
sections.text: تظنّ أنه نفّذ أمراً. لم يفعل.
sections.speaker_directions: The second sentence is the turn. Land «لم يفعل» short and closed, then let the pause carry it.

delivery_cues.delivery_note: The second sentence is the turn. Land «لم يفعل» short and closed, then let the pause carry it.
delivery_cues.provider_text: تظنّ أنه نفّذ أمراً. <break time="0.4s"/> لم يفعل.

enhancement_cues.description: The same line, now with a single flat arrow pointing to an empty box labelled «أمر واحد» — the box is struck through in the accent yellow on the beat of «لم يفعل».

sections.source_ref: audience_insights.misconceptions — 'you describe it once and it comes out finished'

sections.label: يقرأ · ينفّذ · يتحقّق
sections.text: أدار حلقة: يقرأ، ينفّذ، يتحقّق — وتتكرّر.
sections.speaker_directions: Name the three phases on three distinct beats, evenly spaced, so each node can land under its own word. Then stop talking and let the cycle turn once in silence.

delivery_cues.energy: lifts — this is the reveal the whole piece rests on
delivery_cues.delivery_note: Name the three phases on three distinct beats, evenly spaced, so each node can land under its own word. Then stop talking and let the cycle turn once in silence.
delivery_cues.provider_text: أدار حلقة: <break time="0.25s"/> يقرأ، <break time="0.25s"/> ينفّذ، <break time="0.25s"/> يتحقّق — وتتكرّر.

enhancement_cues.description: Annotated object: three nodes snap into a triangle, one per narrated phase, then the whole cycle rotates once — stepped, roughly twelve frames a second, no motion blur. Holds on the completed ring.

sections.source_ref: data_point: three blending phases repeating until complete — code.claude.com/docs/en/how-claude-code-works

sections.label: grep
sections.text: يقرأ: لا يحفظ مشروعك، بل يبحث فيه ويفتح ما يحتاجه.
sections.speaker_directions: This corrects the audience's biggest wrong assumption, so keep it generous rather than clever. No smugness on «لا يحفظ».

delivery_cues.delivery_note: This corrects the audience's biggest wrong assumption, so keep it generous rather than clever. No smugness on «لا يحفظ».
delivery_cues.provider_text: يقرأ: <break time="0.2s"/> لا يحفظ مشروعك، بل يبحث فيه ويفتح ما يحتاجه.

enhancement_cues.description: The cycle rotates to put «يقرأ» on top. A dense file tree fills the frame; a search sweep crosses it and four files ignite in accent yellow while the rest stay near-black.

sections.source_ref: data_point: no vector database, no embeddings — grep plus file reads (secondary, phrased as behaviour not architecture)

sections.label: يعدّل، لا يقترح
sections.text: ينفّذ: يعدّل الملفات نفسها، لا يقترح نصاً تنسخه.
sections.speaker_directions: Short and unceremonious. This beat is the least surprising, so do not inflate it.

delivery_cues.delivery_note: Short and unceremonious. This beat is the least surprising, so do not inflate it.
delivery_cues.provider_text: ينفّذ: يعدّل الملفات نفسها، لا يقترح نصاً تنسخه.

enhancement_cues.description: Cycle rotates to «ينفّذ». A diff stamps into the frame line by line — added lines in accent yellow, removed lines struck through — with no easing, each line arriving on a single step.

sections.source_ref: data_point: it edits the file directly rather than giving you a snippet — code.claude.com/docs/en/how-claude-code-works

sections.label: أحمر ← أخضر
sections.text: يتحقّق: يشغّل الاختبارات، يقرأ الخطأ، يصلحه، ويعيد التشغيل.
sections.speaker_directions: Four verbs, each faster than the last, mirroring the test bar cycling. Then a full stop and a long hold on green.

delivery_cues.energy: the only accelerating line in the piece
delivery_cues.delivery_note: Four verbs, each faster than the last, mirroring the test bar cycling. Then a full stop and a long hold on green.
delivery_cues.provider_text: يتحقّق: يشغّل الاختبارات، يقرأ الخطأ، يصلحه، <break time="0.2s"/> ويعيد التشغيل.

enhancement_cues.description: Cycle rotates to «يتحقّق». A test bar flips red, then red again, then green — each flip landing on a verb, the gaps shortening. Holds on green longer than feels comfortable.

sections.source_ref: data_point: when tests fail it reads the errors, fixes, and runs the suite again — code.claude.com/docs/en/how-claude-code-works

sections.label: نصف العمل
sections.text: هذا النصف الذي لا يظهر في الفيديوهات — وهو نصف العمل.
sections.speaker_directions: The one place the video has an opinion. Slow it right down and let the second half of the sentence sit alone.

delivery_cues.energy: drops deliberately — the editorial line of the piece
delivery_cues.delivery_note: The one place the video has an opinion. Slow it right down and let the second half of the sentence sit alone.
delivery_cues.provider_text: هذا النصف الذي لا يظهر في الفيديوهات <break time="0.45s"/> وهو نصف العمل.

enhancement_cues.description: The ring splits: the «يقرأ/ينفّذ» half stays paper-white, the «يتحقّق» half fills solid accent yellow. Held as a single still frame — the most screenshot-able beat in the video.

sections.source_ref: research underserved_gap: the verification half is almost never shown

sections.label: حتى تنتهي المهمة
sections.text: وتدور الحلقة من جديد، حتى تنتهي المهمة.
sections.speaker_directions: Ride the acceleration of the visual rather than pushing the voice. Finish clean so the final rotation can land in silence.

delivery_cues.delivery_note: Ride the acceleration of the visual rather than pushing the voice. Finish clean so the final rotation can land in silence.
delivery_cues.provider_text: وتدور الحلقة من جديد، حتى تنتهي المهمة.

enhancement_cues.description: The ring spins through several revolutions, each faster and each leaving a faint stepped trail, until it stops hard on a green frame.

sections.source_ref: data_point: repeating until the task is complete — code.claude.com/docs/en/how-claude-code-works

sections.label: مقاطعة · تعديلات محفوظة
sections.text: وأنت داخلها: تقدر أن تقاطعه في أي لحظة، والتعديلات محفوظة قبل أن تحدث.
sections.speaker_directions: Answers the 'what if it wrecks my project' fear. Say it plainly, like someone handing over a key.

delivery_cues.energy: warms — this is the reassurance beat
delivery_cues.delivery_note: Answers the 'what if it wrecks my project' fear. Say it plainly, like someone handing over a key.
delivery_cues.provider_text: وأنت داخلها: <break time="0.2s"/> تقدر أن تقاطعه في أي لحظة، والتعديلات محفوظة قبل أن تحدث.

sections.label: حلقة، لا أمر
sections.text: ليس أمراً واحداً ينفَّذ. حلقة تدور، وأنت فيها.
sections.speaker_directions: Mirror the opening's flatness. No upward lift, no call to excitement. The last word lands and the frame holds past it.

delivery_cues.delivery_note: Mirror the opening's flatness. No upward lift, no call to excitement. The last word lands and the frame holds past it.
delivery_cues.provider_text: ليس أمراً واحداً ينفَّذ. <break time="0.35s"/> حلقة تدور، وأنت فيها.

metadata.schema_note: script.schema.json sets additionalProperties:false on section items, so the per-section metadata keys the script-director recommends (beat_type, animation_mode, hold_time_seconds, visual_priority, narration_plan, text_constraints) are carried here in metadata.section_metadata, keyed by section id, rather than dropped.

word_budget.note: The script-director's budget formula (target_seconds × 2.5 words/sec) assumes English at 150 WPM and yields 150 words for 60s. Arabic carries more per word and runs nearer 2.0-2.2 words/sec, and the same skill's breathing-room rule (a 90s video holds ~60-65s of narration) implies ~42s of narration here, not 60s. 83 Arabic words at ~2.2 wps is ~37.7s of speech against ~16.6s of budgeted holds. Applying the raw 150-word figure would overrun the piece by roughly half. Flagging the deviation rather than silently failing the ±10% check.
word_budget.verdict: deliberate deviation from the English-calibrated formula, documented

arabic_text_rules: Every reveal is word-level — split on spaces only, never per glyph
No letterSpacing on any Arabic text
Arabic containers dir=rtl; Latin tokens (grep, Claude Code) dir=ltr in the Latin face
Reveal direction verified under RTL before the build — LTR-authored typewriter presets run backwards
accuracy_guardrails_applied: Every factual claim carries a source_ref; four of the five mechanism claims trace to the primary Claude Code documentation
The no-index claim (s4) is phrased as observed behaviour — 'does not memorize, searches' — not as an internal architecture claim, because its source is secondary
No model performance numbers, prices or digital specs anywhere in the script
No survey percentages used in this concept, so no attribution burden on screen
s7 is the only line carrying an opinion, and it is labelled as editorial rather than sourced
metadata.timings_provisional: start/end are structural, not calibrated. Once the narration audio exists, re-cut every boundary against the real waveform — the same discipline as the tasmeem project. transcriber (faster-whisper) is missing its python dependency and must be installed before that calibration.
